mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.instance_id, s.node_instance_id, s.requested_by, s.reason, s.supplement_round, s.deadline, s.submitted_at, s.submitted_by, s.submitted_note, s.status, s.created_at FROM flow_supplement s WHERE s.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND s.status = 'pending' ORDER BY s.supplement_round DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.id, s.instance_id, s.node_instance_id, s.requested_by, s.reason, s.supplement_round, s.deadline, s.submitted_at, s.submitted_by, s.submitted_note, s.status, s.created_at FROM flow_supplement s WHERE s.instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY s.supplement_round ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_supplement (instance_id, node_instance_id, requested_by, reason, supplement_round, deadline, status) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{nodeInstanceId}, #{requestedBy}, #{reason}, #{supplementRound}, #{deadline}, IFNULL(#{status}, 'pending'))
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_supplement SET status = 'submitted', submitted_at = NOW(), submitted_by = #{submittedBy}, submitted_note = #{submittedNote} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'
UPDATE flow_supplement SET status = 'overdue' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'
UPDATE flow_supplement SET status = 'cancelled' WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND status = 'pending'
mapper.select: SELECT th.id, th.instance_id, th.node_instance_id, th.seq, th.actor_id, th.actor_name, th.actor_position, th.action, th.opinion, th.signature_id, th.created_at FROM sys_thread th WHERE th.instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY th.seq ASC, th.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_thread (instance_id, node_instance_id, seq, actor_id, actor_name, actor_position, action, opinion, signature_id) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{nodeInstanceId}, #{seq}, #{actorId}, #{actorName}, #{actorPosition}, #{action}, #{opinion}, #{signatureId})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.instance_id, c.user_id, c.source, c.read_at, c.created_at FROM flow_cc c WHERE c.instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY c.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO flow_cc (instance_id, user_id, source) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{userId}, IFNULL(#{source}, 'initiator'))
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_cc SET read_at = NOW() WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
